items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Kirby's Band, except for "Gone With The Wind", it was on all of those early recordings of mine... he had a very good group of musicians with him, Russell Procope, Buster Bailey, Charlie, Billy Kyle.

ctx.x: And actually, the only people that Kirby had with him at the time were Buster Bailey and O'Neil Spencer.
